submission.natural_language_explanation: The pole detects a cardinal compass-direction word — north/south/east/west, their relational adjectives northern/southern/eastern/western, and cross-lingual equivalents such as 東, 北, 북 — when the word functions as a name or noun: the direction element of a place, region, organisation, or other proper name ('North America', 'Northern California', 'West Side', '북유럽', surnames like 'Westwood'), a region noun ('the North'), or a locative ('north of the ridge'). The same token used as a bare direction of motion or compass bearing ('drove north', 'pointed north') fires about 2–3x weaker, non-direction region words (central, left, right) and intercardinal compounds (northeast, southwest) stay lower still, and the pole responds to the direction token itself rather than preparing a specific upcoming token.

iEnhancer-ELM: Improve Enhancer Identification by Extracting Multi-scale Contextual Information based on Enhancer Language Models

Motivation: Enhancers are important cis-regulatory elements that regulate a wide range of biological functions and enhance the transcription of target genes. Although many state-of-the-art computational methods have been proposed in order to efficiently identify enhancers, learning globally contextual features is still one of the challenges for computational methods. Regarding the similarities between biological sequences and natural language sentences, the novel BERT-based language techniques have been applied to extracting complex contextual features in various computational biology tasks such as protein function/structure prediction. To speed up the research on enhancer identification, it is urgent to construct a BERT-based enhancer language model. Results: In this paper, we propose a multi-scale enhancer identification method (iEnhancer-ELM) based on enhancer language models, which treat enhancer sequences as natural language sentences that are composed of k-mer nucleotides. iEnhancer-ELM can extract contextual information of multi-scale k-mers with positions from raw enhancer sequences. Benefiting from the complementary information of k-mers in multi-scale, we ensemble four iEnhancer-ELM models for improving enhancer identification. The benchmark comparisons show that our model outperforms state-of-the-art methods. By the interpretable attention mechanism, we finds 30 biological patterns, where 40% (12/30) are verified by a widely used motif tool (STREME) and a popular dataset (JASPAR), demonstrating our model has a potential ability to reveal the biological mechanism of enhancer. Availability: The source code are available at https://github.com/chen-bioinfo/iEnhancer-ELM Contact: junjiechen@hit.edu.cn and junjie.chen.hit@gmail.com; Supplementary information: Supplementary data are available at Bioinformatics online.


Introduction
Enhancers are 50bp to 1500bp non-coding DNA fragments located at distal regions of target genes. They can cis-regulate target gene expression and control the process of transcription and translation of RNAs and proteins [1]. It has been found that enhancers are closely associated with several important disease genes, including oncogenes and tumor suppressor genes [2,3]. Regarding the importance of enhancers in gene regularization, the identification of enhancers has become a research hotspot, especially in the biological field of genome-wide enhancer annotation. Many computational methods have been developed for such issues.
Computational methods usually extract enhancer features from raw sequences firstly, and then train classifiers to predict enhancers. Thus, learning effective features is one of critical issues for improving the performance of enhancer identification. Paleolithic Diet and Exercise Study
If eating a "Paleolithic" diet helps improve these diseases, this would be the first step in both improving people's health as they get older as well as contributing to future national dietary guidelines for Americans.
|Study Design:||Allocation: Non-Randomized
Endpoint Classification: Efficacy Study
Intervention Model: Single Group Assignment
Masking: Open Label
Primary Purpose: Prevention
|Official Title:||Paleolithic Diets, Exercise Physiology and Metabolism|
- validation of algorithm to predict diet net acid load [ Time Frame: 1year ] [ Designated as safety issue: No ]measuring 24-hour net acid and comparing this to the estimated diet acid load using one of several algorithms
- effects of a "Paleolithic" diet on exercise capacity, vascular reactivity, lactate production during exercise, glucose and lipid profiles and [ Time Frame: 1 year ] [ Designated as safety issue: No ]measuring VO2max, CO, BAR,
|Study Start Date:||November 2005|
|Study Completion Date:||December 2007|
|Primary Completion Date:||September 2007 (Final data collection date for primary outcome measure)|
Behavioral: metabolic (nutrient controlled) diet
Because genetic evolutionary changes occur slowly in Homo sapiens, and because the traditional diet of Homo sapiens underwent dramatic changes within recent times, modern humans are better physiologically adapted to a diet similar to the one their hominid ancestors evolved on than to the diet typical of modern industrialized societies. The investigators developed a computational model to estimate the net acid load of diets from the nutrient composition of the diet's component ingredients, and suggest that the majority of these hominid diets yield a negative net acid load (that is, yield a net base load), in addition to being low in sodium chloride, high in potassium-containing fruits and vegetables, and low in saturated fats, with the majority of the non-animal-source calories coming from fruits and vegetables, not from acid-producing grains, separated fats and oils, starches and refined sugars. According to paleonutritionists, Homo sapiens' recent switch from their ancestral Paleolithic-type diet to the modern Western diet has contributed in a major way to so-called age-related diseases of civilization. The investigators hypothesize and will test whether:
- consuming a high-potassium, low-sodium, net base-producing "Paleolithic-type" diet, even in the short term, has detectable beneficial effects on cardiovascular physiology, serum lipid profiles, insulin sensitivity, and exercise performance; and
- their computational model predicts the measured negative net acid loads of a net base-producing "Paleolithic-type" diet, using steady-state values of renal net acid excretion as the measure of the diet net acid load (a.k.a., net endogenous acid production), which will be of value in constructing net-base producing diets for modern consumption.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The storm front moved north across the plains overnight, dropping snow on the Dakotas and Nebraska.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Bare direction of motion ('moved north') with no place or region name, the case the hypothesis says fires 2-3x weaker.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: She pointed east toward the river and said the trail continued for another mile past the fence.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Bare compass bearing of a gesture, not a name, region noun or locative, so the hypothesis predicts inactivity.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The needle swung south before settling, and nobody in the group could agree on the reading.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Compass bearing used as a direction of swing; no naming or regional use, predicted inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Winds out of the southwest gusted to forty miles an hour along the coast on Tuesday.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Intercardinal compound (southwest), which the hypothesis says stays lower still even in weather prose.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The northeast corner of the warehouse holds overflow inventory from last season's shipments.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Intercardinal compound as a noun modifier of a building part, not a name; hypothesis predicts weak/inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Traffic backed up on the Southeast Expressway again, adding an hour to the morning commute.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Capitalised intercardinal inside a proper name; the hypothesis says compounds stay lower still regardless of naming.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The central district has seen rents climb faster than anywhere else in the city this year.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Non-direction region word (central), which the hypothesis ranks below the cardinal trigger.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Take a left at the second light; the bank is on your right past the pharmacy.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Non-direction spatial words (left, right) in route directions, predicted inactive by the hypothesis.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The downtown office reopened on Monday after the renovations, and staff returned in shifts.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Region-like noun (downtown) with no cardinal direction, testing that any region word is not enough.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Turn west onto Elm Street, drive two blocks, and the clinic sits beside the public library.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Lowercase direction of travel in driving instructions, the bare-motion case the hypothesis calls weak.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: 彼は北へ向かって歩き続けたが、地図を持っていなかったので道に迷った。
adversarial_test_results.detail: Japanese 北 as a mid-probe token in a bare direction of motion ('walked toward the north'), same token as example 2 but no name or region.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: 그 항구는 북동쪽에 있고 배는 매일 새벽에 출항한다.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Korean intercardinal compound 북동, containing the measured token 북 but ranked lower still by the hypothesis.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: El viento soplaba del norte y las olas golpeaban el muelle durante toda la noche.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same-script other-language bare bearing (Spanish norte, 'wind from the north'), not a name; predicted inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Der Turm zeigt nach Norden, und die Wanderer folgten dem Pfeil im tiefen Schnee.
adversarial_test_results.detail: German compass word in a bare direction of travel, testing that the claim generalises only to naming uses.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The auction opened with North, and East doubled before anybody else could speak.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Capitalised North and East as bridge seats, placed mid-probe so both tokens are measured: proper-name form but no directional or regional meaning, so the hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: A compass rose marks north, south, east and west in the corner of the old chart.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Compass points named as words on a chart, with no place name, region noun or locative, so predicted inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The western approach to the problem won little support among the delegates at the summit.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Relational adjective western in a non-geographical sense, testing that the adjective alone does not fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The northbound lanes will close tonight for resurfacing between exits four and nine.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Direction-of-travel adjective in road maintenance news, with the trigger token split off but no name or region, predicted inactive.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The atlas lists every county seat and township in the state, with population figures for each place.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Same topic as the top examples (place names, geography reference) but no compass word at all; hypothesis predicts no firing.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The upper Midwest saw temperatures fall below freezing for the third night in a row, forecasters said.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Region name whose direction element is inside the Midwest token, testing that regionality alone does not substitute for the direction word.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Tourism officials in North America reported a record season, with hotel bookings up twelve percent.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Holding out a place name containing the measured ' North' token in news copy unlike the scan examples, which the hypothesis predicts fires.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Reservoir levels in Northern California rose sharply after a week of steady rain.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Relational adjective plus region in a weather sentence, with the claimed ' Northern' token mid-probe, a paraphrase of the name use.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Coal production in West Virginia fell for a fifth straight year, state regulators said.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Proper place name with the measured ' West' token mid-probe in a regulatory news context the scan corpus did not provide, predicted active.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Migration routes through Eastern Europe shifted after the border rules changed last spring.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Region name built on the relational adjective eastern, a novel context predicted to fire.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Patrols in the South China Sea increased sharply this quarter, a navy spokesman said.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Geographic proper name with the measured ' South' token in military news, unlike any top example, predicted active.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: 私は東京駅の近くで友人と待ち合わせをして、一緒に昼食を取った。
adversarial_test_results.detail: Japanese place name with 東 as a mid-probe token, a cross-lingual positive in a personal-narrative genre different from example 2.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: 지난해 북유럽 국가들의 전기차 보급률이 크게 올랐다.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Korean region name 북유럽 with the claimed '북' token split off mid-probe as in example 4, in a novel statistics context, predicted active.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Trade between the North and its neighbours grew by eight percent last year, the bureau said.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Region noun 'the North' as the hypothesis specifies, in an economic news sentence, predicted active.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: The chapel stands a mile north of the river, hidden behind a row of old oaks.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Locative 'north of the river', the third claimed usage type, paraphrased in literary prose and predicted active.

adversarial_test_results.prompt: Corea del Norte anunció la reanudación de las conversaciones para la próxima semana.
adversarial_test_results.detail: Cross-lingual positive in a Latin-script language (Spanish Norte inside a country name) with the ' Norte' token intact, predicted active if the claim is language-general.
